samples.question: Black lines are walls, and connected white areas are chambers. Two chambers are neighbors only when they share a black wall segment; touching at a corner does not count. For counting distance, one step crosses one shared wall into a neighboring chamber. Which colored dot is in the chamber whose farthest chamber is the fewest steps away? Answer orange, green, or purple.
